question.content: 費城博物館的一尊4英呎 x 4英呎大理石雕像和紐約博物館的一尊6英呎 x 3英呎青銅雕塑的平均價格是多少？

function_schema.name: get_sculpture_details
function_schema.description: Retrieves details of a sculpture, such as its material and size, from a museum database.

museum_location.description: Location of the museum housing the sculpture.

function_schema.name: get_artwork_price
function_schema.description: Retrieves the price of a sculpture based on size and material.

museum_location.description: Location of the museum housing the sculpture.

model_result_raw: [get_artwork_price(museum_location="Philadelphia Museum", sculpture_material="marble", sculpture_size=[4, 4]), get_artwork_price(museum_location="New York Museum", sculpture_material="bronze", sculpture_size=[6, 3])]

question.content: "請問你能幫我訂製一尊20英吋大的大理石馬雕塑，接著再訂製一尊15英吋大的木製狗雕塑，然後是一幅以紅色為主色調的30英吋大的日落畫作，最後再訂製一幅以藍色為主色調的25英吋大的城市風景畫嗎？"

function_schema.name: sculpture.create_custom
function_schema.description: Order a custom sculpture with your preferred material.

item.description: The subject of the sculpture, e.g. horse

size.description: The desired size for the sculpture in inches. This parameter is optional. Default is 10 inches if not specified.

function_schema.name: painting.create_custom
function_schema.description: Order a custom painting with your preferred color.

subject.description: The subject of the painting, e.g. horse

color.description: Preferred main color for the painting.

size.description: The desired size for the painting in inches. This parameter is optional. Default is 20 inches if not specified.

model_result_raw: [sculpture.create_custom(item="horse", material="Marble", size=20), painting.create_custom(subject="dog", color="Red", size=15), sculpture.create_custom(item="horse", material="Wood", size=20), painting.create_custom(subject="cityscape", color="Blue", size=25)]

question.content: "你能幫我計劃我的旅行嗎？我需要在巴黎預訂一間酒店房間，住5晚。我偏好豪華房間，並希望加上早餐和水療服務。之後，我需要在巴黎租一輛車，租期為7天。我偏好SUV，並且我會在機場取車。然後，我需要在羅馬預訂另一間酒店房間，住3晚。我偏好套房，並希望加上機場接送服務。最後，我需要在羅馬租一輛車，租期為5天。我偏好緊湊型的轎車，並且我會在酒店取車。"

function_schema.name: car.rental
function_schema.description: Rent a car at the specified location for a specific number of days

days.description: Number of days for which to rent the car.

car_type.description: Type of the car to rent.

pick_up.description: Location of where to pick up the car. Default is 'airport' if not specified.

function_schema.name: hotel.book
function_schema.description: Book a hotel room given the location, room type, and number of nights and additional services

roomType.description: Type of the room to be booked.

nights.description: Number of nights to book the room for.

items.description: Additonal services that can be booked.

additional_services.description: Additional services to be added. Default is not use it if not specified.

model_result_raw: [hotel.book(location="Paris", roomType="deluxe", nights=5, additional_services=["breakfast", "spa services"]), car.rental(location="Paris", days=7, car_type="SUV", pick_up="airport"), hotel.book(location="Rome", roomType="suite", nights=3, additional_services=["airport pickup"]), car.rental(location="Rome", days=5, car_type="compact sedan", pick_up="hotel")]
